summary.zh: 用竞争假设并行排查并裁定根因
summary.en: Investigate competing root-cause hypotheses in parallel

description.zh: 围绕逻辑、数据、并发、配置、环境、依赖六类故障模式提出多个竞争假设，分派并行调查、收集证据，最后按证据强弱裁定根因。适合问题有多个可能原因、初步排查无果，或缺陷横跨多个模块时使用。
description.en: Generates competing hypotheses across six failure-mode categories, runs parallel investigations, collects evidence, and arbitrates the root cause. Use it when a bug has several plausible causes or spans modules.
